title: Elf Bar ElfLiq Grape Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: If you’ve ever tried a Grape flavour Elf Bar then you’ll know just how delicious this new Elfliq e-liquid is. Juicy, sweet and succulent Grape candy is a classic flavour that never fails to satisfy and makes for an endlessly uplifting all-day vape that all vapers can enjoy. Elfliq e-liquids are Elf Bar’s most iconic flavours in 10ml bottles of nicotine salt e-liquid. With a 50% VG / 50% PG concentration, Elfliq liquids produce a discreet amount of flavour-rich vapour with a smooth, comfortable throat hit, and provide rapid relief from nicotine cravings. Elfliq nicotine salt e-liquids are available in 10mg or 20mg nicotine strength and are ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
